rationale: Eliminates the $18.3k cash deficit by accelerating early-game workforce scaling to 10 hands via a lean $120 hurdle (closing the critical early labor gap), unlocking earlier town shop seed procurement while extending high-margin (2.0x-3.5x) shop deliveries through Day 30, and correcting the dynamic feed reserve to zero when no livestock are present. Additionally embeds price-elasticity batch pacing (3-5 units) and dual peak-price arbitrage into Oracle Frontrun, while cutting off late non-maturing seed purchases after Day 25 and guaranteeing systematic terminal liquidation on Days 29-30.
